name: @luthfanwakan/tempuh
description: The player for QTI 3.0 content built on olah: rendering, the PCI host, accessibility in the UI and the server-side integrations.
author: Fariz Wakan (https://github.com/luthfanwakan)

scripts.clean: node --eval "for (const path of ['dist', 'tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm clean && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-frame.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.check:packages: pnpm build && publint --pack pnpm --strict && attw --pack . --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./player.css
